description: This file contains unit tests for the PDFsharp library, specifically testing classes related to measurement units such as XUnit and XUnitPt. It uses the xUnit testing framework and FluentAssertions for assertions. The tests verify conversion methods, equality, comparison operators, and string parsing for these measurement classes.

classes.name: GlobalsTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods for verifying the functionality of XUnit and XUnitPt classes related to measurement conversions and operations.

methods.name: XUnit_Test
methods.description: Performs comprehensive tests on the XUnit class, including conversion methods, string parsing, equality, comparison, and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: XUnitPt_Test
methods.description: Performs comprehensive tests on the XUnitPt class, similar to above but for the point-based measurement units.

methods.name: XUnit_vs_XUnitPt_Test
methods.description: Tests conversions and equality between XUnit and XUnitPt classes.

methods.name: XUnit_No_commas_allowed_anymore_Test
methods.description: Verifies that parsing XUnit from string does not accept commas as decimal separators, ensuring correct format validation.
